Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust

Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust.
An open-source, clean-room take on the Adobe Premiere Pro workflow: native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly. By the ArtCraft team.
Premiere 26's full Video Effects bin (93 effects in 16 folders), the Legacy bin and the obsolete effects old projects use, plus around 30 transitions.
What's Changed
- fix: preserve individual linked-clip selections through deletion by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1639
- fix(interchange): avoid UTF-8 slice panics in file URLs by @nuclearspike in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1609
- fix(media): preserve Unicode prefixes in image-sequence filenames by @nuclearspike in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1570
- fix(export): prevent nested renderer-pool deadlocks by @earlvanze in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/861
- ci: delegate FreeBSD workflow to craft-common-actions and add nix check by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2124
- ci: standardize FreeBSD workflow on shared FreeBSD 15.1 action by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2158
- Follow stored media paths only on this computer or the project's share by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2304
New Contributors
- @nuclearspike made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1609
Full Changelog: https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0
